home.title: Trading without a tie
paragraphs: My name is Vladimir. I am passionate about trading and trading automation — I create what I use myself.
In my free time, I prefer independent travel across Russia and around the world, on anything that moves, and even on foot.

trading.title: Trading
paragraphs: Trading means buying and selling currencies, cryptocurrencies, company shares, government bonds and other financial instruments through a brokerage company on electronic trading platforms.
The purpose of these transactions is to profit from price changes.
A trader is a person who carries out these transactions, independently deciding when to buy and sell financial instruments.
Copy trading allows you to automatically replicate a trader's trades in your brokerage account, even without trading experience.

Once you connect to copy trading, the broker's system automatically opens and closes trades in your account. You do not need to analyse charts, find suitable moments or make decisions about each trade yourself.

fmb.title: Trading robots
paragraphs: Trading robots emerged as a way to automate the actions performed in trading by a person — a trader.
Trading means buying and selling currencies, company shares and other financial instruments through a brokerage company with the aim of profiting from price changes.
Trading robots are computer programs that automatically perform a trader's work, strictly following a predefined algorithm.
A robot does not sleep, get tired or give in to emotions. It can monitor price changes around the clock and place trades when trading is available, without constant human involvement.

All detailed information about trading robots, including notifications, project news, monitoring, trading statistics, articles, recommendations, subscription terms, the project's social media and much more, is collected in the Telegram bot.

guide.title: T-Capital — copy trading connection guide
guide.intro: To connect to the trade copying service, you need to complete a few simple actions: register with the broker, configure the copying rules, create an account and fund it with at least $1000. Copying will start automatically after funding.
guide.howto: Follow the steps in order. After completing each step, tick “Done” in its heading — this will automatically open the next step.
guide.risk: Copying trades involves the risk of losing some or all of your funds. Past trading results do not guarantee similar results in the future. You independently decide whether to connect to copy trading and how much money to use.

steps.title: Register with the broker
items: Enter your country of residence and email address, and create a new strong password.
Or sign in with your Google/Facebook account.
Important: your country is not listed? Choose the nearest one; the system will specify the correct country during document verification.

steps.title: Verification
items: Important: verification requirements depend on the country: in some countries you need to complete it immediately, in others only when funding your account. If nothing appears after following the link, do not worry — your verification will take place at the funding stage.
Verify your identity: passport or national ID card.
Verify your address: any document with your full name and address (utility, internet or mobile phone bills, or a bank statement).

steps.title: Configure copying and fund your account
items: Click “Copy” on the T-Capital leader's profile.
In the window that opens, set the copying multiplier = 1 (one).
Open “More settings” → enable “Scale after the leader closes their trades” (leave the other settings unchanged).
Scroll down → in the “Account” section: “Create a new account” → “Copy” — the funding page will open.
Fund the account with at least $1000.
Choose a method: bank card or cryptocurrency.
If the method you need is unavailable, complete verification to unlock it.
Copying will start automatically after funding.

complete: You can now follow trading results on the broker's website or in the MetaTrader 4 app.

faq.q: What is the copying multiplier? Why should it be set to 1?
a: The copying multiplier is a coefficient used to calculate the volume of copied trades, taking into account the ratio between the trader's (leader's) deposit and your account deposit.
Set the multiplier to 1 (one) when connecting. This avoids having to calculate the coefficient yourself and risking a settings error.
After the leader's trade closes, the enabled automatic scaling function will recalculate copying volumes as provided for by the broker.
It is therefore important to set the multiplier to 1 and enable “Scale after the leader closes their trades”.

faq.q: What should I do if the email with my account details has not arrived?
a: Check your Spam folder and other email folders.
If you cannot find the email, contact the broker's support team to recover or clarify your account access details.
If necessary, you can ask for help contacting the broker's support team.

faq.q: Where can I follow trading results?
a: You can follow trading in your Markets4you broker account.
You can also use MetaTrader 4 by connecting to the trading account with the investor password.
The Markets4you mobile app is additionally available in some countries.

faq.q: What alternative funding methods are available?
a: Available funding methods depend on your country and the settings of your broker account.
In addition to bank cards, electronic wallets and other methods, including cryptocurrency, may be available.
If the method you need is not shown, complete verification. Additional funding options may become available afterwards.

Trading does not take place around the clock, but when the necessary market conditions and trading signals are present. Sometimes several days or weeks may pass between trades. There is also no trading on weekends.
To make sure copying is connected correctly, sign in to your Markets4you broker account.
In the side menu, open “Copy trading” → “Copying rules”.
The list should contain the copying rule you created. By default, the broker names rules Rule 1, Rule 2, Rule 3 and so on.
If you have several rules, make sure the relevant rule relates to the T-Capital leader, if this information is displayed in your account.
If the rule is missing, repeat the connection procedure following the guide.
If the rule still does not appear after reconnecting, contact technical support at support@vladimir1.com or the Markets4you broker's support team.
An investor password is a special password for viewing a trading account in MetaTrader 4.
It allows you to observe open and closed trades, the balance and trading results.
It does not allow you to place trades yourself or withdraw money from the account.

faq.q: Can I withdraw funds at any time?
a: You can submit a withdrawal request around the clock.
If your identity has not been verified before, the broker may require verification before the first withdrawal. Usually, you do not need to repeat it for every withdrawal.
With copying active, a normal withdrawal requires you to disable copying first, then reconnect after withdrawing the funds.
The exception is the broker's commission charge days, which occur twice a month. On those days, withdrawals may be made without disabling copying.
Request processing times depend on the broker and the withdrawal method selected.

faq.q: What is leverage and what account type is needed for copying?
a: Copying uses a Classic Pro account with leverage of 1:2000.
Leverage determines the ratio between the size of a trading position and the required collateral.
High leverage allows less money to be used as margin for a position of a given size.
For the same position size, a price change produces the same financial result regardless of the leverage selected.
However, leverage does not eliminate market risks or the risk of insufficient margin.

privacy: General provisions
This Privacy Policy defines how information related to the use of Vladimir1.com, including T-Capital and Fast Money Bot, is processed.
Use of the website
Vladimir1.com does not provide visitor registration, personal accounts or submission of personal data through built-in forms.
The website does not use advertising pixels or third-party visitor behaviour tracking systems.
The selected interface language and progress through the guides are saved directly in the user's browser using local storage.
These settings are not sent to the website's own database and can be deleted by the user through browser tools.
Email
When contacting support@vladimir1.com, the sender's email address, message content and voluntarily provided information may be processed.
The information received is used to consider the enquiry and prepare a reply.
The legal basis for such processing may be the pursuit of legitimate interests relating to the consideration of incoming enquiries, provided the data subject's rights and freedoms are respected.
Correspondence is not published, used for advertising mailings or shared with third-party organisations for marketing purposes.
Email correspondence is received and stored using email infrastructure.
Do not send passport details, passwords, payment details, brokerage account numbers or other confidential financial information to the support address.
For brokerage account and financial transaction matters, contact the relevant broker's support team directly.
Correspondence is kept for the time needed to consider the enquiry, or where other legal grounds for its retention exist.
Technical information

When the website is visited, hosting and technical infrastructure providers may process the IP address, browser and device information, and technical request parameters needed to provide access to the pages.
Vladimir1.com does not use this information to independently create visitors' advertising profiles.
Third-party resources
When following links to third-party resources, information is processed in accordance with the respective services' terms and policies.
Vladimir1.com does not determine how independent third-party organisations process personal data.
Fast Money Bot Telegram bot
Only Telegram user identifiers (Telegram ID) are stored in the Fast Money Bot Telegram bot's own database for its operation.
User names, nicknames, phone numbers and message content are not stored in the bot's own database.
An automated frequently asked questions response system and artificial intelligence technologies using the OpenAI API are used to handle user enquiries.
When responses are generated using artificial intelligence, the content of the relevant requests is transmitted through the OpenAI API for processing and response generation.
Users can also contact support directly through Telegram.
Information processing by the Telegram platform itself is governed by that service's terms and privacy policy.
Information protection

Personal data enquiries
Requests for information about personal data processing, correction, restriction of processing or deletion are considered in accordance with applicable law.

risks: Trading financial instruments, copying trades and using trading robots involve the risk of losing some or all of your funds.
Past trading results, monitoring figures and trading algorithm test results do not guarantee similar financial results in the future.
Copied trading results may differ from those of the source trading account due to differences in execution conditions, capital amounts, copying settings and other circumstances.
Trading robots operate according to their programmed algorithms and may make both profitable and loss-making trades.
The effectiveness of trading algorithms depends on market conditions, configuration parameters, the characteristics of the trading platform used and the quality of trade execution.
Using leverage increases both potential profit and possible losses.
Financial market volatility, insufficient liquidity, slippage, technical failures and order execution delays may significantly affect trading results.

Decisions to register with a broker, choose a trading platform, trading strategy and a specific participant whose trades are to be copied, connect to trade copying services, use trading robots, and determine trading parameters and the amount of money involved are made by the user independently, at their own discretion, based on their own assessment of the relevant services' terms of use and the associated financial risks.
